datasets.title: South Africa Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 3.2 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 13% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 3 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 7% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset includes approximately 3.2 million buildings with metadata on data age and recent updates, representing an estimated 13% of total buildings in South Africa based on AI-mapped estimates.
